description: Set or clear the `resolver` and `metadata` pubkey pointers on a .cook name you own. The program stores them without interpreting them — they are hooks for apps. Pass "none" to clear one. At least one of `resolver`/`metadata` is required. Requires COOKIE_PRIVATE_KEY.

metadata.description: metadata account (base58), or "none" to clear it

name.description: the .cook name, with or without the suffix (e.g. "bot" or "bot.cook")

resolver.description: resolver account (base58), or "none" to clear it

name: update_domain
title: Update a .cook name's pointers
